entities.summary: Bishop Mykola Semenyshyn is a Ukrainian Greek Catholic hierarch as Titular Bishop of Iunca in Mauretania and Auxiliary Bishop of the Archeparchy of Ivano-Frankivsk since 27 October 2022.
